preservedResponsibilities: CSV byte conversion uses the original single-byte descriptor conversion procedures and OString/OUString conversion flags for the authenticated ported registry; Unicode writes little-endian UTF-16 and UTF-8 uses browser byte primitives.

Native UTF-8 OStringToOUString now consumes the existing pinned SAL converter with the source final FLUSH flag instead of host TextDecoder. Preserves native grouping of broken, overlong, surrogate and five-byte sequences, BOM retention and output-length bounds. Seven new malformed/signature cases plus actual Markdown callback admission cover this path. Other pre-existing string conversion branches, including UTF-8 encoding, remain independently unverified.
omittedResponsibilities: Full SAL converter registry, contextual/multibyte converters, complete stream ownership and every original constructor/error contract remain unported. The original SAL dummy conversion now handles missing registry entries.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Keep the newly connected byte-conversion wrappers adjacent to the existing ustring owner while the remaining original inline OUString helpers stay in sal/inc/rtl/ustring.ts.
